[This is a second-price (Vickrey) auction with independent private values and no prior history. Truthful bidding is a dominant strategy: bid your true value ($8). You will win only when the second-highest bid is below $8, and you pay that second price, guaranteeing nonnegative profit when winning. Do not overbid—no benefit and risk of negative payoff. Bid in $0.1 increments: 8 is valid.]
